Location: Eaton Administration Office - Council Chambers

Recording - In accordance with the Local Government Act 1995 and Local Government (Administration) Regulations 14(I)(8)(a)(b) & (c) the Shire of Dardanup wishes to advise that due to technical failure with the recording equipment, a recording of the 17th of September 2025 Special Council meeting is not available.  At the time of the meeting the recording was active and therefore no secondary recording was activated.  Review of the recording has found that while video is available there is no audio available for the recording as a result of technical failure.
